- Provides read-only actions for latest news, article search, supported categories, languages, and regions.
- Guides users to inspect live connector schemas before running `oo connector run` payloads.
- Supports keyword, taxonomy, language, region, and time-range news workflows through the `currents_api` connector.
- Includes setup and troubleshooting guidance for oo CLI auth, app connection, expired credentials, and billing errors.
